speaker: Clark G. Gilbert
role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
title: Teach Truth with Love
summary: Elder Gilbert teaches that standing for truth takes courage, and standing for truth with love takes more; he amplifies five principles President Oaks taught: avoid contentious settings, find common ground first, be a light, hold to truth while reaching out, and stay anchored in Christ. His stories cut both ways: an angry retort that won a debate but lost a struggling friend, and two hours of listening in one home that brought five people to stake conference. He asks each of us to look at our own heart first, and says teaching truth with love will be the hallmark of Christ's disciples in the last days.
